what: A 48px icon button expands to the text width in .25 seconds on hover, and the text slides in from 5px to the right and settles in .8 seconds. On release it returns to icon only in .2 seconds — the phone·directions·booking buttons of the fixed pillar beside the screen

options.[data-fx-part=label]: Text revealed when expanded (child) — if absent, only the width expands

note: Expanded width is measured from the actual width of the first inner child (button) each time the pointer hovers. Touch devices stay folded and tapping goes straight to the link

from.where: shared.js [data-unfold] · three .jo-mask buttons in the left pinned column (original .sticky_container > .left .button_list .mask)
